H01.description: The bounds check `byte_length + byte_offset > buffer.byte_length()` can overflow usize (wrapping in release builds), so a huge byte_length/byte_offset passes the check and an out-of-bounds DataView is created (or a panic in debug builds).

H02.description: Adds a regression test for the overflowing offset + length case.

H03.description: Parameterizes the out-of-range test helper over byte_length/byte_offset.

H04.description: Test helper uses its new parameters instead of hard-coded values.

H05.description: Adds test entry points for the out-of-range and overflow cases.

H06.description: Registers the new overflow test export.
